# Genuine accounts-schema7 upgrade fixtures

Generated by `tools/generate-category-schema7.py` through a private, unmodified
server build of commit `4772f400d9889800bd4a15d19f151e2ac5314416` (accounts schema7).
All setup, edits, read snapshots and backup downloads use the public HTTP API.
SQLite files are copied only after that server stops. ZIPs are unmodified server
backup downloads; the generator asserts their original manifest schema is7.

- `category-native-schema7.*`: native category, exact -1250 transaction, two
  accounts, grouped membership, account/group reordering, multiline notes.
- `category-import-schema7.*`: activation of pinned Actual26.10 fixture
  `import-26.10.0.zip`, then native category, transaction category/note edit,
  account grouping/order/notes. Its source category metadata is absent from the
  schema7 category projection and is enriched on schema8 upgrade/restore.
- `.json` records public snapshots and full immutable HTTP receipts.
- `.sqlite3` exercises migration; `.zip` exercises archive normalization.

`server/tests/categories_schema7.rs` runs both cases through both public paths.
It verifies unchanged account/group/transaction snapshots, category defaults or
source metadata, exact old receipt replay, unchanged upgrade epoch, and new
restore epoch. No test mutates fixture schema or derives expected values from
the schema8 implementation.

Reproduce with a private `git archive 4772f40 actualBudget/server actualBudget/web`
checkout/build and `python tools/generate-category-schema7.py /private/server`.
